question: what are government budget deficits
answer: A government budget deficit occurs when government expenditures exceed its revenue in a given period, typically a year. It is an indicator of financial health and represents the amount by which spending surpasses income. Deficits contribute to the accumulation of national debt over time [p_0171189e1bd2219c9a49][p_d9f3b9ffb6e1eaf64770][p_16e67b7d9c06f8067729][p_9fe60323a156d35e15c9].
